# Vishal Rashmika

> Software Engineer & Systems Developer | Cybersecurity Researcher based in Sri Lanka. Software engineer, systems developer, and cybersecurity researcher specializing in systems programming, reverse engineering, web applications, and scalable architecture.

## Overview
Vishal Rashmika is a Software Engineer and Systems Developer based in Sri Lanka, specializing in systems programming, reverse engineering, cybersecurity, and scalable web architecture. Serving as Co-Founder & Tech Lead at OlyraLabs with deep experience across low-level development, security tooling, and full-stack software.

## Core Competencies
- **Languages:** C, C++, x86-64 Assembly, Rust, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C# / .NET, SQL, HTML/CSS
- **Systems & Security:** Reverse Engineering, Penetration Testing, Linux System Internals, Binary Disassembly, Debugging & Symbol Analysis, Network Protocols, OCI Security
- **Web & Frameworks:** Astro (SSG / Islands), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Node.js, Express, Vite, RESTful APIs
- **Cloud & Infrastructure:** Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Linux Administration, Git, Netlify, Agile / Scrum Leadership

## Key Projects
- [LangDetect.Net](https://www.nuget.org/packages/LangDetect.Net) [.NET, C#, NLP, Algorithms] - 280+ downloads ([Live Demo](https://www.nuget.org/packages/LangDetect.Net)): A lightweight, self-contained .NET package for text-based language detection supporting 12 languages. Uses three algorithmic strategies to improve accuracy and has 280+ NuGet downloads.
- [WyrdLang](https://vishalrashmika.com) [Compilers, C++, Java, Systems]: A custom programming language with fantasy-inspired keywords. Built with a custom-made interpreter in C++ and paired with WyrdPad, a lightweight IDE written in Java.
- [SinSo API](https://sinso-portal.vishalrashmika.com) [REST API, Backend, Node.js, Open Source] ([Live Demo](https://sinso-portal.vishalrashmika.com)): The largest open source Sinhala lyrics API, offering access to 10,000+ song lyrics through a RESTful API with a community submission portal.
- [PopQuest](https://popquest.github.io/) [Web App, JavaScript, Frontend, Interactive] ([Live Demo](https://popquest.github.io/)): An interactive web application built as a polished, playful public experience.
- [Blossom Theme](https://blossomtheme.github.io/) [UI/UX Design, Themes, Blender, Styling] - 2,300+ downloads ([Live Demo](https://blossomtheme.github.io/)): A software color theme inspired by Japan’s vibrant urban aesthetics. Co-founded the organization and contributed to multiple variants.
- [Life Via Lens](https://vishalrashmika.com) [Photography, Media, Visual Storytelling, Arts]: A photography and visual storytelling project focused on framing everyday moments with a cinematic eye.
- [Nyxia](https://vishalrashmika.com) [Mobile App, Flutter, Dart, Astrophotography]: An astrophotography planning app for better nights under the stars. Built in Flutter with weather insights, celestial tracking, calculators, and event management.
- [Rejuvenation Clinic](https://rejuvenationclinic.lk) [Web, Healthcare, Client Solution, UI Design] ([Live Demo](https://rejuvenationclinic.lk)): Medical clinic website for Rejuvenation Clinic, built as a clean public-facing brand and service presence.
